response.sql: WITH income_with_dept AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, maj.department FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id), dept_counts AS (SELECT department, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as member_count FROM income_with_dept GROUP BY department), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(member_count)::REAL as total FROM dept_counts), dept_shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, member_count::REAL / (SELECT total FROM total_sum) as share FROM dept_counts), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as average_share FROM dept_shares), filtered_depts AS (SELECT member_count, share, (SELECT average_share FROM avg_share_calc) as avg_share FROM dept_shares WHERE share > (SELECT average_share FROM avg_share_calc)) SELECT SUM(member_count) as sum_of_counts, AVG(share) as avg_of_shares, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_of_diffs FROM filtered_depts
